name: @dsh-plugin/dsh-network-settings
description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that bundles three network capabilities — User-Agent rewriting (from @dsh-plugin/dsh-user-agent), a HTTP / HTTPS-CONNECT / SOCKS5 proxy (from dsh-net-proxy), and configurable request auto-retry — all driven from a single 网络设置 (Network) tab in the Web settings.
